methodology.search: stock TVM MetaSchedule EvolutionarySearch and XGB, not a static sweep
methodology.scope: existing contraction schedule knobs; no proposed CPU/packing knobs
methodology.shared_deadline: Existing study deadline; maximum four hours, do not reset during handoff
methodology.limits: Abort when measured active non-startup cycles >= current best for the same task; refresh in flight; retain censored trials
methodology.parallelism: One driver per actual physical slot, common locks and proposal ledger; bounded CPU builds
methodology.validation: FireSim guest checks all outputs; no mandatory sequential Spike preflight on remote
methodology.promotion: Structural TIR/target equality and fresh hardware evidence; connected confirmation then baseline/tuned E2E
